certified_release_session_limit_note: E146 (EVIDENCE.md, 2026-09-09): this promotion is certified ONLY for N<=8 simultaneous VNEXT_B+MTTCG sessions (core/src/mcu/qemu/VnextBCapacityGuard.hpp::kVnextBCertifiedReleaseSessionLimit). The raw host-topology ceiling this runtime's own capacity guard computes can be higher (13 on the 32-logical-processor host this episode measured), but that number was never validated end-to-end and must not be treated as certified capacity -- see that header's own comment. N=9 through N=16 are explicitly NOT certified by this promotion; a later episode may raise this limit, but only alongside fresh B11 evidence at the higher N, in the same commit that raises kVnextBCertifiedReleaseSessionLimit.
runtime_requirements: MSYS2 UCRT64 DLLs staged beside executable
production_topology: VNEXT_B+MTTCG (tcg,thread=multi -- one TCG thread per vCPU) is the only supported/validated production configuration for this runtime. SINGLE_REALTIME and ICOUNT are explicitly experimental/diagnostic modes with their own separate, still-open findings (a pre-existing CPU0-frozen-PC stall under SINGLE_REALTIME, EVIDENCE.md E118; an open MWDT_SYS_STAGE reset under VNEXT_B+ICOUNT, EVIDENCE.md E115) -- neither investigated, fixed, or gated in this promotion. Do not treat either as validated by this entry.
promotion_history_E146: E146 (EVIDENCE.md, 2026-09-09): promoted the E141-production-clean candidate (475C0FC9...) to canonical, limited to a certified N<=8 VNEXT_B+MTTCG Release release. Preflight confirmed the candidate SHA, zero running QEMU, H143 (McuComponent::pollAndDispatchPendingEvents()) still wired to decidePostAckRearm(), HARNESS_BUILD_CONFIG=Release, LASECSIMUL_REQUIRE_RELEASE=1. Along the way, found and fixed a real, reproducible STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN crash in VnextBProductionScaleTest.cpp's negative N=9 capacity-rejection path (a rejected session's Scheduler/attachment was left torn down only at final teardown instead of immediately, corrupting shared state under concurrent real-QEMU sessions) -- fixed by calling stopSimulation() immediately on rejection, verified crash-free across 8+ direct runs (parallel and sequential) after the fix. Also fixed run_production_mwdt.ps1's own external timeout budget (a rejection scenario's extra concurrent-startup contention under processor-affinity restriction genuinely takes longer, up to ~131s observed, not a hang) and added an explicit CAPACITY_REJECTED_AS_DESIGNED classification so a correctly-refused over-capacity request is no longer misreported as a generic runner failure. Pre-promotion gates: capacity guard pure+concurrency tests 64/64, vnext_b_attachment_test PASS, mcu_component_live_poll_thread_test PASS, session_restart_stress_test 15/15, 5 QEMU-side unit tests PASS (unaffected, same QEMU binary), full VNEXT_B+MTTCG Release regression 14/14, B11 N=8 PASS (8/8, clean), negative N=9 CAPACITY_REJECTED_AS_DESIGNED. RESET_WAIT/E131 deliberately NOT used as a promotion gate this episode -- E131_LEGACY_DIAGNOSTIC_ORACLE_RETIRED_AFTER_PRODUCTION_TRACE_REMOVAL (its own oracle depends on 4 diagnostic tracers E141 correctly removed from production; this is a harness/oracle incompatibility, not a functional regression). N=9 through N=16 deliberately not attempted/certified this episode -- see certified_release_session_limit_note.
provenance: E118-AUDIT-2 (2026-09-05): ROOT-CAUSE FIX for the VNEXT_B+MTTCG watchdog-reset storm found auditing E118-AUDIT's own promotion gate (2 of 10 attempts, 9 and 15 unexpected SW_CPU_RESET_REGISTER resets respectively). Both flagged attempts showed the identical signature: exactly one 'Blocked re-entrant IO on MemoryRegion: esp32.i2c at addr: 0x4' warning immediately after the app-cpu-startup reset and immediately before the first unexpected reset, then a repeating alternating-CPU reset cycle with incrementing boot_epoch for the rest of the run. Root cause, confirmed by direct source-code proof (softmmu/memory.c:546-575): every device-owned MemoryRegion's dispatch wrapper sets mr->dev->mem_reentrancy_guard.engaged_in_io=true on entry and clears it via a plain post-call statement ONLY on a normal return from the device's .write callback. E118's own fix has vnext_b_gpio_write() respond to VNEXT_WOULD_BLOCK (a real vCPU hitting a momentarily-full VNEXT_B lane) with cpu_stop_current() + cpu_loop_exit_restore() -- a siglongjmp back into cpu_exec() that unconditionally skips every intervening return, that cleanup included. The first time this fired from inside a reentrancy-guarded device's own dispatch (observed: esp32_i2c's A_I2C_CTR register write), engaged_in_io was left stuck true FOR THE REST OF THE PROCESS -- every subsequent access to that device was rejected outright (MEMTX_ACCESS_ERROR), which is what actually drove the guest's own repeated watchdog-triggered reset/recovery cycle, not a transport-timing or host-scheduling-contention issue (E113's H4 hypothesis is not implicated here). Fixed by setting disable_reentrancy_guard=true on every device MemoryRegion reachable through writeReg()'s VNEXT_B/cpu_loop_exit_restore() path: hw/i2c/esp32_i2c.c, hw/char/esp32_uart.c, hw/gpio/esp32_gpio.c, hw/ssi/esp32_spi.c, hw/misc/esp32_ledc.c, hw/misc/esp32_sens.c, hw/misc/esp32_iomux.c -- the same idiom already used by hw/intc/apic.c, hw/scsi/lsi53c895a.c, hw/misc/bcm2835_property.c, hw/ppc/pnv_lpc.c, hw/intc/loongarch_ipi.c. Safe specifically because this retry path never drops the BQL, so the cross-vCPU race this guard exists to catch (a second vCPU dispatching into the same device during a BQL-released window, e.g. the LEGACY arena's arenaTransactionBegin()) cannot occur through VNEXT_B's synchronous, BQL-held call chain. Validated: a bounded 12-attempt real-firmware reproduction with the fix showed 0/12 storms and 0/12 'Blocked re-entrant IO' warnings (vs. the pre-fix combined sample of 2 storms in 16 attempts); the official 10-attempt promotion gate (re-run with the ALSO-fixed runner, see below) passed 10/10 including unexpectedResets=0 on every attempt. Fixing this exposed a separate, narrower, EXPLICITLY NOT YET RESOLVED finding: at an artificially tiny test-only LASECSIMUL_VNEXT_B_LANE_DEPTH=2 (not the production default), a real vCPU's now-unconditionally-persistent WOULD_BLOCK retry can out-compete the UART TX bottom-half's own cross-process credit-available notify for freshly-freed lane credit often enough to starve it for an extended window -- not reproduced at the production gate's actual (larger) default lane depth, and not chased further in this entry; see EVIDENCE.md E118-AUDIT-2 and NEXT_ACTION.md. Separately, this entry fixed an inconsistency in the E118-AUDIT gate runner itself: its pass/fail calculation never included unexpectedResets, so both flagged attempts were incorrectly recorded as "pass": true in phase6_mttcg_results.json -- extracted into a shared, unit-tested Get-Phase6AttemptClassification (vnext_prototype/mttcg_causality/E118-AUDIT/phase6_gate_lib.ps1 + phase6_gate_lib_test.ps1), and the existing evidence was re-classified in place (not re-run) to correct the record. Prior provenance (E118-AUDIT): two further real production gaps found and fixed -- UART's uart_write() silently dropping a byte's Core-facing effect once its 128-entry backlog (tx_effects[]/tx_effect_count) reached capacity while tx_fifo kept draining independently (fixed: block the calling vCPU before fifo8_push(), replay via cpu_loop_exit_restore() once uart_wake_backlog_waiters() frees a slot); esp32_i2c_do_transaction()'s current_cpu==NULL timer continuation advancing lastCMD/arming the next step on an unpublished VNEXT_WOULD_BLOCK (fixed: leave the completion timer unarmed, revert RSTART's own lastCMD++, retry via esp32_i2c_vnext_credit_available()). vnext_ring_classify() (include/softmmu/vnext_b_classify.h) extracted as a pure, unit-tested function for the occupancy<depth/==depth/>depth contract. Prior provenance (E118): VNEXT_B's original INVALID_BOOT root-cause fix -- vnext_b_gpio_write()/vnext_b_i2c_submit()/vnext_publish_request() used to treat an ordinary full ring (occupancy==depth) identically to genuine corruption (occupancy>depth), both hard-fatal; UART's TX bottom-half (current_cpu==NULL) hitting that branch set the fatal flags without stopping anything, and shared-lane-0 I2C submissions then silently failed for the rest of the run. Fixed with an explicit VNEXT_PUBLISHED/VNEXT_WOULD_BLOCK/VNEXT_FATAL contract. Prior provenance (E117): VnextBAttachment::prepare()/activate() two-phase startup, closing a registration-ordering race between QEMU's first guest activity and Core's wait-dispatcher registration. Prior provenance (E116): startup-barrier candidate (autostart=0, vm_start() gated on Core RUNNING). Prior provenance (E114-AUDIT/E114/E113/E111/E109): see this field's own history before E116, unchanged and superseded only in the sense that this is now a different binary built from a superset of that same fix.
last_validated_test: tests/unit/test-vnext-b-classify: 9/9 PASS. tests/unit/test-esp32-timg-pause: 7/7 PASS (unaffected). vnext_b_attachment_test (full suite, P1-P8/R3A/R3C/E117/E118/E118-AUDIT/E118-AUDIT-2, including E118_AUDIT_UART_BACKLOG_NO_LOSS and E118_AUDIT_I2C_CONTINUATION_NO_DESYNC with an added 'Blocked re-entrant IO' regression guard): PASS, zero regressions, re-confirmed against the staged canonical path itself post-promotion. run_regression.ps1 -Transport VNEXT_B -ExecutionMode MTTCG: 13/13 PASS x2 (e118audit2_v1, e118audit2_v2). -Transport LEGACY -ExecutionMode MTTCG: 13/13 PASS (e118audit2_legacy1). Phase 3 bounded reproduction (12 attempts, stop-at-first-storm protocol): 0/12 storms, 0/12 'Blocked re-entrant IO' warnings. Official Phase 7 promotion gate (vnext_prototype/mttcg_causality/E118-AUDIT-2/phase7_gate_final.ps1, using the fixed Get-Phase6AttemptClassification): 10/10 PASS, no retries -- setup_valid, workload_pass, terminal_clean, exactly-one-app-cpu-startup, submissions==completions>0, artifactFatal=0, unexpectedResets=0, zero orphans on every attempt. See EVIDENCE.md E118-AUDIT-2. E146 (2026-09-09): full VNEXT_B+MTTCG Release regression 14/14 against this candidate; B11 N=8 PASS (8/8, clean); negative N=9 CAPACITY_REJECTED_AS_DESIGNED; capacity guard pure+concurrency tests 64/64. Post-promotion re-confirmation against THIS canonical path: vnext_b_attachment_test PASS, session_restart_stress_test 15/15, full VNEXT_B+MTTCG Release regression 14/14, B11 N=8 PASS (8/8, clean, affinity/priority confirmed), negative N=9 CAPACITY_REJECTED_AS_DESIGNED. Zero QEMU orphans at every checkpoint.
